Bootstrap Grid 5.3.8 — MIT licensed.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap-grid.min.css
Documentation: https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/layout/grid/

The official compiled grid CSS is included at the start of each page stylesheet
to keep each stylesheet complete and the downloaded website usable offline.
Only the source map reference was removed. Custom MPILO rules follow it.
